changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Map each advisor username to ADVISOR_SELF role in n_user_role_mapping. is_primary = true only when username has no existing primary role.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO n_user_role_mapping (username, role, is_primary, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, version) SELECT DISTINCT a.username, 'ADVISOR_SELF', NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_user_role_mapping urm2 WHERE urm2.username = a.username AND urm2.is_primary = true), 'migration', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'migration', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 FROM n_advisor a WHERE a.username IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM n_user_role_mapping urm WHERE urm.username = a.username AND urm.role = 'ADVISOR_SELF' );
